answer: Each submission hangs on the lantern of a task receipt, and the relic is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
